$comment: Shared RFC-8 validation cases consumed by both py/test/test_rfc8_validation.py and ts/test/rfc8_validation_test.ts. The message and location strings pin the cross-language byte contract: both ports must raise them verbatim. A case without a version validates with no declared version (the strict default).

cases.name: minimal collection with empty nodes
collection referencing its nodes by path
prefixed extension path type passes as opaque
names may repeat across sibling collections
a non-collection node may carry neither nodes nor path
the rules are inert when an earlier version is declared
missing type on the root node
cases.message: Spec rule [node-type-required] violated: Node must declare a non-empty string 'type'; got None.

cases.name: empty type string
cases.message: Spec rule [node-type-required] violated: Node must declare a non-empty string 'type'; got ''.

cases.name: non-string type on a child node
cases.message: Spec rule [node-type-required] violated: Node must declare a non-empty string 'type'; got 5.

cases.name: missing name on the root node
cases.message: Spec rule [node-name-required] violated: Node must declare a non-empty string 'name'; got None.

cases.name: empty name on a child node
cases.message: Spec rule [node-name-required] violated: Node must declare a non-empty string 'name'; got ''.

cases.name: sibling nodes sharing a name
cases.message: Spec rule [node-name-unique] violated: Node name 'img' is repeated; node names must be unique within the enclosing collection.

cases.name: id with characters outside the production
cases.message: Spec rule [node-id-format] violated: Id 'a b' does not match [a-zA-Z0-9-_.]+.

cases.name: non-string id
cases.message: Spec rule [node-id-format] violated: Id 7 does not match [a-zA-Z0-9-_.]+.

cases.name: id repeated across the document
cases.message: Spec rule [node-id-unique] violated: Id 'n1' is already used in this document; ids must be unique within the JSON document.

cases.name: collection declaring both nodes and path
cases.message: Spec rule [node-nodes-xor-path] violated: Node declares both 'nodes' and 'path'; exactly one must be present.

cases.name: collection declaring neither nodes nor path
cases.message: Spec rule [node-nodes-xor-path] violated: Node declares neither 'nodes' nor 'path'; exactly one must be present.

cases.name: path without a type
cases.message: Spec rule [path-type-known] violated: Path must declare a non-empty string 'type'; got None.

cases.name: unprefixed path type outside the core set
cases.message: Spec rule [path-type-known] violated: Path type 'google-sheet' is not 'zarr', 'json', or a prefixed extension type.

cases.name: name uniqueness reported before the id format
cases.message: Spec rule [node-name-unique] violated: Node name 'img' is repeated; node names must be unique within the enclosing collection.
